platforms.khizana.title: Hadhramout digital library (the Khizana project)
platforms.khizana.about: The Hadhrami Khizana project is an electronic programme for collecting and classifying Hadhrami knowledge in all its forms — documents, manuscripts, books, research and theses, newspapers and magazines — to build an electronic information bank. It has been run by Dar Al-Wifaq Al-Haditha for publishing and distribution since 2018, in active partnership with Yemeni public universities and publishers, academics, and research centres and societies in Yemen, to raise Hadhrami knowledge to the level of international databases and make it easy for researchers worldwide to reach.
platforms.khizana.vision: An organised scholarly information environment in every branch of Hadhrami knowledge.
platforms.khizana.mission: To serve Arab academic researchers and their peers with specialised Yemeni scholarly databases on the model of international ones, to bring them within reach of researchers, and to enrich Yemeni and Arabic scholarly content on the internet.
platforms.khizana.goal1: Survey Hadhrami scholarly output in every field, in manuscript and in print, in all kinds of publications: books, journals, conferences, seminars and more.
platforms.khizana.goal2: Digitise that output to high quality standards.
platforms.khizana.goal3: Catalogue, index and structure Hadhrami scholarly content to international standards.
platforms.khizana.goal4: Build specialised Yemeni databases in every field of human knowledge.
platforms.khizana.goal5: Partner with scholarly publishers: universities, learned societies and commercial publishers.
platforms.khizana.goal6: Make Hadhrami sources — manuscripts, books, journals, documents and conference proceedings — easier to reach for researchers in the Arab world and beyond by publishing them online.
platforms.khizana.done: More than 700,000 pages of books, research, articles and studies on Yemen in history, geography and biography have been added. It started modestly and has grown into one of the largest electronic libraries on Hadhrami affairs — still far from what we aspire to.
platforms.khizana.nextLabel: Ambitions for the five years from January 2026 to the end of 2030
platforms.khizana.next1: Extend coverage to every field of Hadhrami science and knowledge.
platforms.khizana.next2: An ambitious plan to add one million more pages of Hadhrami books, research and theses.
platforms.khizana.next3: An ambitious plan to add 10,000 archived and classified pages of Hadhrami manuscripts.
platforms.khizana.next4: An ambitious plan to add 500,000 archived and classified pages of historical documents.

podcast.title: Saqaya podcast
podcast.lead: Conversations with leading figures of Hadhramout's cultural and social life, produced by the Center.
podcast.text: «Saqaya» is one of the Center's recent media productions, presented by Abdullah Salah Bareaa. It hosts people active in the cultural, social and political life of Hadhramout and beyond, in unscripted conversations about their own experience and their views on collective memory, historical change and the concerns of journalism and culture. Through the variety of its guests and the depth of its conversations, Saqaya builds a bridge between generations and presents oral heritage in a contemporary, professional format, in support of the Center's work in documentation and preservation.
